subject: general
question: Where did Anahat Singh win the women's squash title in 2025?

options.text: SRFI Indian Tour PSA Challenger tournament in Chennai
Indian Open 2025 PSA Copper event in Mumbai
Indian Open 2025 PSA Gold event in Delhi

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Open 2025 PSA Copper event in Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Anahat Singh clinched the women's squash title at the **Indian Open 2025 PSA Copper event held in Mumbai**.
 
• The tournament is recognized as a **Professional Squash Association (PSA) Copper event**, attracting top players from around the globe.
 
• The event was held in Mumbai, a city known for hosting significant sports tournaments and fostering squash talent in India.
 
• Anahat Singh showcased exemplary skill and determination to win this prestigious title, contributing to her growing reputation in the squash world.
 
• This victory marks a significant milestone in her career, highlighting her as one of India's promising squash players.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PSA Tournaments:**

 
 
• The Professional Squash Association (PSA) organizes tournaments globally, categorizing them as Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Copper events based on prize money and ranking points.
 
• Copper events are considered entry-level tournaments, often serving as platforms for emerging players to gain ranking points and experience.
 
 
 
• **Anahat Singh:**
 
 
• Anahat Singh is a young Indian squash player who has gained recognition for her performances in national and international tournaments.
 
• She has previously represented India at the Commonwealth Games and other global squash events, earning accolades for her skill and dedication.
 
 
 
• **Squash in India:**
 
 
• Squash is a growing sport in India, with increasing participation and success at international levels.
 
• Organizations like the Squash Rackets Federation of India (SRFI) play a key role in promoting the sport and nurturing talent.
 
 
 
• **Major Squash Events:**
 
 
• India hosts several PSA-recognized events to provide exposure to domestic players and attract international talent.
 
• These events help develop the squash ecosystem in the country and elevate its status globally.
